title: Your music library, tidied up.
lead: Playlist tools that clean up years of saving, and AI suggestions built from what you actually play.
loginCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can keep exploring the demo.
loginForbidden: This account isn’t on the invite list yet. The demo works without one.
loginFailed: Sign-in didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
loginUnavailable: Sign-in isn’t set up on this deployment. The demo is fully available.

tools.title: Playlist tools
tools.text: Find duplicates, merge, sort and split playlists. Preview every change and undo it.

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.text: Describe a mood or pick a playlist; get tracks you have not worn out, with a reason for each.

demo.title: Open demo
demo.text: Every tool runs on a fictional library in a private sandbox. Nothing touches a real account.

previewTitle: Every screen works in the demo.
previewText: The demo is a fictional listener with a dozen playlists and real tool flows. Edit, dedupe, merge and generate — it all runs against a private sandbox that resets when you leave.
whyInviteText: Streaming services limit personal developer apps to a handful of approved accounts. Everyone else gets the full demo.
yourDataText: Tokens stay on the server, encrypted. Disconnect any time and everything Rewind stored about you is deleted.
openSourceText: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase. Read the code and the architecture notes on GitHub.
disclaimer: Rewind is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify.
